method.scope: Existence of a same-reference tuple in the admitted static source; not executed searches, all numeric ranges, inventory or current validity.

limits: Region, commune, delivery and state are project facts within their source scope; amenities additionally require compatible reference type/use.
A tuple does not establish every additional filter or joint range. Use the separately pinned existing acceptance certificates for engine behavior.
Missing active attributes fail closed; inactive unknown attributes do not remove otherwise supported results.
Prices and surface profiles in different references cannot be joined.
Iris prices remain external, and original local24a is not published.
